story.soThat: my chosen marble is already selected when I reach the configurator, saving time and creating a seamless browsing experience

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Clicking "Create My Cube" (Créer Mon Cube) on marble detail page navigates to configurator Navigation target: /[locale]/configurator?marble={slug} Marble slug is passed as URL query parameter Navigation preserves current locale
Theme transition from light (Carrara Pure) to dark (Nero Marquina) is smooth Transition duration: 0.5s ease Cinematic fade effect between themes No jarring color flashes or layout shifts

Invalid or missing marble slug is handled gracefully If marble param is missing → default to first available marble If marble param is invalid (doesn't exist in DB) → default to first available marble No error displayed to user, seamless fallback

Configurator marble selector shows pre-selected marble as active URL parameter ?marble={slug} initializes Zustand store state Marble selector UI highlights the pre-selected marble User can immediately adjust dimensions and finish without re-selecting marble

Quick-configure action from gallery cards (if available) Gallery cards can have a quick-configure CTA overlay Clicking triggers same navigation flow as detail page CTA Same URL parameter pattern: /configurator?marble={slug}
Browser back button returns to previous gallery/detail page Navigation uses standard Next.js Link/router Browser history is preserved correctly User can return to their discovery journey

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR34: Users can navigate directly from gallery item to configurator with that marble pre-selected. This enables the "Inspiration First" user journey.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Configurator route at /[locale]/configurator/page.tsx. Uses React Three Fiber for 3D rendering. Zustand for state management at src/stores/configStore.ts.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Configurator uses dark theme: Background #0D0D0D, Surface #1A1A1A, Accent #C9A962. Cinematic fade transition from Carrara Pure (white) to Nero Marquina (dark) when entering configurator.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.snippet: AC-2.6.1: Clicking "Create My Cube" navigates to /configurator?marble={slug}. AC-2.6.2: Theme transition is smooth (0.5s). AC-2.6.3: Invalid/missing marble slug defaults to first available. AC-2.6.4: Configurator shows pre-selected marble as active.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Pre-selection flow: User on gallery/detail → Click "Configure with this marble" → Navigate to /configurator?marble={slug} → Configurator reads URL param, initializes store → 3D view loads with selected texture.

constraints.constraint: Server Component for URL parsing: Configurator page should be a Server Component that reads URL params and passes validated marble to client components
Client-side store: Zustand store manages configuration state; initialized from URL param on mount
Theme switching: Use CSS custom properties defined in Tailwind config for light/dark theme transition
Graceful degradation: Must handle edge cases (invalid slug, missing param) without breaking UX
Naming convention: React components use PascalCase (ConfiguratorClient.tsx), stores use camelCase with Store suffix (configStore.ts)
Server Actions pattern: Use Zod for validation, return ActionResponse type
This story creates the SHELL for the configurator. Actual 3D viewer, controls, and full configuration UI are in Epic 3.
